quest_aurelia_aqueduct_survey.description: Lyra needs a current survey of the Broken Aqueduct before Aurelia sends road crews into the Aurelian Outlands.

stages.completion_dialogue: A real measurement beats ten confident guesses. The crews will have a route they can use.
stages.description: Reach the Broken Aqueduct in the Aurelian Outlands, then return to Lyra at the Surveyors' Hall.

quest_aurelia_aqueduct_survey.title: Measure of the Old Road

quest_aurelia_observatory_report.description: Elion needs an on-the-ground report from Aurelia's dangerous abandoned observatory before the museum risks sending a scholarly expedition.

stages.completion_dialogue: You saw the dome for yourself and returned with useful detail. That is better than the heroic speculation the museum usually receives.
stages.description: Reach the Old Observatory in the Aurelian Outlands, then report back to Elion at the museum.

quest_aurelia_observatory_report.title: The Silent Dome

quest_aurelia_starwell_record.description: Elion believes the damaged archive beneath Aurelia's museum holds the missing observatory record, if its last imperial sentinel can be overcome.

stages.completion_dialogue: The record is damaged, but it is real. You have recovered a piece of the city that even Aurelia had filed under legend.
stages.description: Descend through the museum's eastern archive door, defeat an astral sentinel in the Starwell Chamber, then return to Elion.

quest_aurelia_starwell_record.title: The Starwell Record

stages.description: Confront the Lieutenant.

objective.approach: "The village sent me. But I would rather hear your side than draw on you."

fail.dialogue: He laughs and steps in. Wrong answer, then.

success.description: You convinced him to stand down. Peace is possible.
success.dialogue: He lowers his blade and spits into the dirt. Fine -- tell them we are done here. For now.

dialog.greeting: Hold! You have the look of someone sent by the village. I am willing to listen before I spill your blood. What do you want?

stages.description: Kill the Lieutenant.

quest_bounty_dire_wolf_alpha.description: One of the dire wolves near the mountains has grown unusually large and cunning, leading raids on travelers. Guard Captain Elara doesn't know its name, only that it's far more dangerous than the rest of its kind -- and is offering a bounty for whichever one it is.

stages.completion_dialogue: One of the strong ones, dead? Good riddance. That bounty is well earned.
stages.description: Hunt down and kill an elite dire wolf.

quest_bounty_dire_wolf_alpha.title: Bounty: An Elite Dire Wolf

quest_bounty_troll_elder.description: Something old and enormous has been sighted in the mountains -- a troll far larger than any on record. Guard Captain Elara wants it put down before it wanders toward the roads.

stages.completion_dialogue: That thing's been a rumor for months. You've done Riverside a real service.
stages.description: Hunt down and kill an elite troll.

quest_bounty_troll_elder.title: Bounty: A Monstrous Troll

stages.description: Deliver the Peace Treaty to the Bandit King.

quest_frostpeak_deep_sounding.description: Mara Vale needs a fresh report from the dangerous ice chamber above Frostpeak before the Mining Lodge risks another crew.

stages.completion_dialogue: You made it to the chamber and came back with your senses intact. That is enough to save a crew from walking in blind.
stages.description: Reach the Inner Ice Chamber beyond Frostpeak's frozen waterfall, then report back to Mara at the Mining Lodge.

quest_frostpeak_deep_sounding.title: A Sounding in the Ice

quest_investigate_smuggling.description: Investigate the source of Portbridge's smuggling rumors.

stages.completion_dialogue: An underground cache? So it's true -- someone's running goods through my harbor without paying a cent in tariffs. Find out who's behind it. Carefully.
stages.description: Search the harbor district for signs of smuggling activity.

quest_investigate_smuggling.title: Something's Not Right at the Docks

quest_kill_bandit_king.description: Put an end to the rebellion by slaying the King.

stages.description: Kill the Bandit King in the forest clearing.

quest_kill_bandit_king.title: Regicide

quest_local_provisions.description: Talia wants a sample of local herbs and softwood to show buyers upriver.

stages.completion_dialogue: Just what I needed. This'll do nicely for upriver.
stages.description: Gather a sample of wild herbs and softwood from anywhere in the region.
stages.start_dialogue: Bring me a sample of local herbs and softwood, from wherever you find them.

quest_local_provisions.title: Local Provisions

quest_missing_guard.description: Guard Captain Elara needs help tracing the disappearance of a recruit along the river road.

stages.completion_dialogue: By the gods... this is his tabard. And it's covered in strange slime. Take this to Kaelan the Alchemist immediately.
stages.description: Search the abandoned mill beyond Riverside Docks for the missing guard's tabard.
stages.start_dialogue: One of my recruits went missing near the river. Please, see if you can find any trace of him.

stages.completion_dialogue: Hmm. River Troll slime. Acidic and foul. The beast must be nearby. Slay it before it takes more victims!
stages.description: Show the Bloody Tabard to Kaelan the Alchemist in Riverside.
stages.start_dialogue: Go to Kaelan. He will know what creature left this slime.

stages.completion_dialogue: The beast is dead? You have done the village a great service today.
stages.description: Find and slay the River Troll at the Stagnant Pool in Murkwater, downstream from Riverside.
stages.start_dialogue: The troll is the cause. Kill it.

quest_missing_guard.title: The Missing Guard

quest_museum_showcase_commission.description: Curator Vane is seeking a display-worthy stone: refine one yourself, or source a suitable specimen through other pursuits.

stages.completion_dialogue: The cut catches the light beautifully. This will help visitors see the valley's treasures anew.
stages.description: Bring Curator Vane one display-worthy stone by any accepted route.

quest_museum_showcase_commission.title: A Light for the Museum

quest_river_fine_token_commission.description: Elder Thorne seeks a carefully made river-clay token using unusually fine local material.

stages.description: Craft a River Fine token and deliver it to Elder Thorne.

quest_river_fine_token_commission.title: A Token Worth Keeping

quest_riverside_charm_commission.description: Elder Thorne needs a carved charm for a new household settling near the river.

stages.description: Craft a carved Riverside charm and deliver it to Elder Thorne.

quest_riverside_charm_commission.title: A Riverside Welcome

quest_scout_forest.description: Scout the forest to locate the bandit camp.

stages.completion_dialogue: You found it? Good. We need to deal with their leader.
stages.description: Locate the Hidden Camp in the Whispering Woods.

quest_scout_forest.title: Eyes in the Woods

quest_smuggler_contact.description: Confront whoever is running the smuggling operation beneath Portbridge.

stages.description: Confront the smugglers' leader in the underground cache.

objective.approach: "I did not come here to make trouble. I came here to make a deal."

fail.description: She doesn't like your terms. Steel is drawn.
fail.dialogue: Her smile goes flat. Pity. I liked you.

success.description: You strike a deal. Welcome to the crew.
success.dialogue: She grins and spreads her hands. Now that is the language I speak.

dialog.greeting: Well now. You found us. Question is -- what are you going to do about it? I could use someone with your nerve... for the right price.

stages.description: The negotiation failed. Deal with the smugglers' leader.

quest_smuggler_contact.title: The Smuggler's Offer

quest_smuggler_delivery.description: Bring the dubious cargo to the smugglers to seal the deal.

stages.completion_dialogue: Good. This is what trust looks like. You've got a share coming to you.
stages.description: Deliver the dubious cargo to the smugglers' leader.

quest_smuggler_delivery.title: Cutting You In

quest_sunscorch_oasis_survey.description: Sada the Caravanmaster needs a current report from the Mirror Oasis before committing an incoming caravan to the desert road.

stages.completion_dialogue: You reached the oasis and returned with a report instead of a rumour. That is the difference between a route and a gamble.
stages.description: Reach the Mirror Oasis across the Sunscorch Expanse, then report back to Sada in the Caravan Yard.

quest_sunscorch_oasis_survey.title: Water on the Route

quest_tidewell_clear_vault.description: Harbourmaster Voss needs the drowned enforcer in Tidewell's Blackwater Vault dealt with before Portbridge can reclaim the flooded works.

stages.completion_dialogue: The vault is no longer held against us. Portbridge can finally put people and pumps into Tidewell.
stages.description: Defeat the drowned enforcer in the Blackwater Vault, then return to Harbourmaster Voss.

quest_tidewell_clear_vault.title: Clear the Blackwater

quest_tidewell_soundings.description: Harbourmaster Voss needs a current report from Tidewell's lowest vault before Portbridge commits a crew to the flooded underworks.

stages.completion_dialogue: A clear sounding gives Portbridge a chance to deal with the water before it deals with us.
stages.description: Reach the Blackwater Vault in the Tidewell Underworks, then report back to Harbourmaster Voss.

quest_tidewell_soundings.title: Soundings Below the Docks

quest_wildflower_commission.description: Elder Thorne would like a hand-tied wildflower posy for the village's newest residents.

stages.completion_dialogue: A small kindness, thoughtfully made. Riverside is fortunate to have you here.
stages.description: Gather herbs, craft a wildflower posy, and deliver it to Elder Thorne.

quest_wildflower_commission.title: A Posy for Riverside
